'''Toth''' was a [[drouk]] who was controlled by Handler [[Murdok]], a member of the [[Warstalkers/Legends|Warstalkers]], on [[Denova]]. Toth and another drouk, [[Zorn]], were slain in battle in [[3639 BBY]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Toth appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a boss in the "Explosive Conflict" operation.
